data.one_liner: Access device, platform, target, and app version information via an inherited widget.
data.what_it_does: Bundles device_info_plus, package_info_plus, and version into a single AppInfo inherited widget. Automatically fetches async information at app launch and makes it available to every widget in the tree while safely handling web platform restrictions.
use_when: You need global access to app version, package info, and device/platform specifications.
You want to avoid repeatedly writing async utility code for device and package details across projects.
avoid_when: You only need to check a single isolated device property without an inherited widget setup.
You prefer calling native plugins directly rather than through a wrapper package.
strengths: Provides a unified AppInfoData structure available anywhere in the widget tree.
Automatically handles platform safety and restrictions on the web.
Exposes structured SemVer version objects for easy comparison.
weaknesses: Requires wrapping the root of your application with an async setup in main().
Brings in multiple dependencies (device_info_plus, package_info_plus, version).
data.setup_notes: Update the main() function to wrap the root application with AppInfo using await AppInfoData.get().
